correctness.rationale: Over C, for n≥3, 1≤p≤n−2, the reduced common support of quadric and two-p-plane degree-two Chow components is exactly unordered pairs of p-planes lying in a (p+1)-plane. The ordered incidence P(S∨)×_{Gr(p+2,n+1)}P(S∨) is irreducible, generically 2:1 over the common support, dimension D=(p+2)(n−p−1)+2p+2. The pullback of the actual Chow O(1) is H=x+y−2c1(S), the sum of the two individual Plücker hyperplanes; it is not the relative x+y quadratic-bundle class. Consequently 2deg Z=∫H^D. Projective-bundle pushforwards and equivariant Grassmannian localization yield the stated exact rational finite sum, integral by geometry. Annihilator duality exchanges p↔n−p−1 while preserving H. In the p=1 case, expected-codimension Thom–Porteous and Pieri/ballot reflection yield the independent binomial formula. Independent exact-rational binomial calculations gave n=3,4,5,6,7 values 140,6300,288288,13453440,638516736. Finite values corroborate but the general geometric intersection calculation is the proof; the claim concerns the reduced support, not scheme intersection multiplicities.

originality.rationale: The closely related same-day published component-degree theorem calculates both full components Q_{p,n} and R_{p,n}, not their reduced intersection Z; component degrees do not determine a proper lower-dimensional intersection degree. Bürgisser et al. (2015) calculate component degrees 92 and 140 for (p,n)=(1,3); the intersection degree coincides numerically with 140 in that base case, but the original source does not give the all-parameter common-stratum degree, and other values differ. Chen–Hu–Ma (2026) introduces the common incidence geometry and cohomology, leaving its possible evaluated Chow degree a serious priority risk because full material could not be obtained through lawful arXiv/OA/institutional access in this run. On checked statements, the evaluated all-parameter Chow-embedded degree and line-pair binomial expansion remain a distinct motivated exact invariant, with best-of-knowledge novelty qualified.

value.rationale: The canonical overlap of the two components of the degree-two Chow variety is a natural geometric stratum. Its degree in the actual Chow-form polarization is not fixed by the separately known component degrees and is a useful exact enumerative invariant. The result supplies all-parameter Grassmannian localization, duality and a closed infinite family of line-pair degrees, with meaningful corrections for the true polarization rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
